notes: Ludum Dare 44 jam (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/44/clunky-bird; https://danielerdmann.itch.io/clunky-bird) by ditzel / DitzelGames. Complete Unity 2019.1.0f2 project with playable SampleScene in EditorBuildSettings (left-click to shoot, Space for a bomb). MIT at repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2019 D. E.). Official Unity packages only (Lightweight RP 5.7.2, TextMesh Pro 2.0.0, Timeline, and built-in modules; ads/analytics/purchasing listed but not vendored as assets). No TMP assets or fonts are bundled in the repo. Source art under src/Models/ (Blender and PSD) and a press GIF under src/Press/ are retained. Omitted Unity Logs/. No DOTween, no EmojiOne, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL. ~28M src snapshot.
